sections.title: Describe weekend plans
sections.content: Use ir a + regular present-tense verbs in the infinitive to describe planned weekend activities.

sections.title: Weekend plans
rows: I am going to visit a friend.
Voy a visitar a una amiga.

items.english: On Saturday I am going to study.

items.spanish: El domingo voy a visitar a mi familia.
items.english: On Sunday I am going to visit my family.
We are going to cook on Saturday.

sections.content: The second verb stays in the infinitive: voy a estudiar, vas a trabajar, vamos a cocinar.
